importWizard.title: Document import
importWizard.step1Desc: Select documents or a Data Room archive for import. This is currently a UI placeholder, but it visually matches the working wizard.
importWizard.step2Desc: Refine parameters before launching import and document preprocessing.
importWizard.forceReclassifyDesc: Re-run HybridClassifier for all documents before analysis. Useful if documents were renamed or the Data Room structure changed.

prepared.title: Files ready for upload
prepared.subtitle: Review the file set before sending to the project.

dropzone.title: Drag documents here
dropzone.desc: You can upload individual files or an entire folder. Once the set is ready, proceed to upload to the project.

steps.0: After selecting and uploading files, we will proceed to the document analysis launch block.
steps.1: Before launching the analysis, you will need to select the set of risks to check.
steps.2: After launch, the system will perform extraction, chunking, classification, and risk analysis.
steps.3: Based on the analysis results, the system will build a DD Grid of document risks.

layoutDebug.title: Document before and after sanitation
layoutDebug.subtitle: Only changed words are highlighted in the left column.
layoutDebug.description: Original text is on the left, sanitized is on the right. If a line changed, only modified words are highlighted in the left column; if a line was deleted completely, the entire line is highlighted.
layoutDebug.empty: No data available to compare raw / sanitized layout.
layoutDebug.emptyDesc: Verify that the debug-layouts request is called with includeraw=true and includesanitized=true.

tooltips.composite: Composite file: contains several legal documents
tooltips.needsReview: Classifier is low confidence, manual review required

chunksModal.title: Document in Chunk Format
chunksModal.description: This view shows the document exactly as the chunking system "sees" it: one chunk after another, complete with headers and system metadata. Scroll down to see the entire document.
chunksModal.empty: No chunk data available to display.

upload.restricted: You do not have permission to upload documents to this project.

header.title: Upload Documents
header.subtitle: Prepare a set of files and upload them to the project.

existing.title: Already Uploaded Documents
existing.subtitle: Documents that are already present in the project.
existing.empty: There are no uploaded documents in this project yet.

errors.selectFilesFirst: Please select files or a folder to upload first.

emptyState.title: No documents yet
emptyState.subtitle: Upload documents via the Overview tab

documentsTab.title: Documents
documentsTab.subtitle: The project analyzes {{count}} {{label}}
documentsTab.subtitleEmpty: No documents have been uploaded to the project yet

columnSelector.title: Visible columns
columnSelector.subtitle: Click a field to show or hide it in the table
columnSelector.applyTitleDisabled: Change the visible columns set first

languageSelection.title: Primary analysis language required
languageSelection.descriptionFallback: Document upload complete. For documents with several detected languages, processing will not continue until the primary analysis language is selected. Russian is set by default.

classification.lowConfidence: ⚠️ Low classification confidence ({{percent}}%) — please verify the document type
classification.triggersHint: The document type together with the triggers listed above describe the review scenarios applied to the document.
classification.notPerformed: Classification not performed or document is being processed
classification.reclassifiedWarning: The document has been reclassified. Risk analysis for the new type will only run when the full deal analysis is restarted. Per-document recalculation will be added later.

quarantine.title: Document in quarantine
quarantine.hint: Replace the file with a valid version to restart processing.
quarantine.downloadError: Failed to download the original file.

headerSection.originalUnavailable: Original file is not available yet
headerSection.downloadUnavailable: Downloading the original is currently unavailable

structuredData.emptyNotAvailable: There are no extracted values for this document yet. Run the analysis or refresh the page after the review completes.
structuredData.emptyProcessing: Structured data is being processed. Refresh the page in a few minutes after the analysis finishes.
structuredData.singleDescription: The file is analysed as a single document. Extracted values are shown in one shared context.
structuredData.multiDescription: The file contains several logical segments. Extracted values are grouped by segment.
structuredData.emptySegment: No data for the selected segment yet.
structuredData.emptySegmentHint: Try selecting a different segment or refresh the page after the analysis completes.
structuredData.emptyValuesInSegment: No extracted values in this segment yet.

reviewSection.emptyMessage: No review results for this document in DD Matrix yet.

filename.label: Document Name
filename.description: File name of the document in Data Room.

folder_path.label: Folder
folder_path.description: Folder path in Data Room structure.

status.label: Processing Status
status.description: Current processing status of the document in the pipeline.

reviewed_by_person.label: Reviewed Flag
reviewed_by_person.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the document was reviewed by a lawyer.

classification_requires_review.label: Needs Review
classification_requires_review.description: Flag indicating classifier marked document as requiring manual review.

page_count.label: Pages
page_count.description: Number of pages in the document.

classification_level.label: Classification Level
classification_level.description: Level at which document type was determined (L0–L4, L_manual).

applicable_triggers_count.label: Triggers
applicable_triggers_count.description: Number of applicable check triggers for the document.

created_at.label: Created
created_at.description: Date and time when the document was added.

updated_at.label: Updated
updated_at.description: Date and time of last document update.

deal_id.label: Deal ID
deal_id.description: Identifier of the deal the document belongs to.

composition_type.label: Composition
composition_type.description: Single or multi-document file (by segment structure).

segment_count.label: Segments
segment_count.description: Number of segments / logical documents in the file.

primary_segment_label.label: Primary Segment
primary_segment_label.description: Name of the primary segment (e.g. main SPA).

is_composite_file.label: Composite File
is_composite_file.description: Flag indicating the file contains multiple logical documents.
